description_for_human: Browse discounted golf cart inventory, check financing options, and find store locations across 14 dealerships.
description_for_model: Use this plugin to help users find golf carts for sale at Discounted Golf Carts. You can retrieve inventory (new and used), financing options (0% APR, multiple lenders), store locations across 9 states, and brand/model information. The dealership sells electric and gas golf carts, street-legal LSVs, and lifted carts from 13 brands. Inventory is updated daily. Phone: 1-888-840-4490.
